name: container-choice
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: invalid @whitespace: none @root @nestedCaptures @mapping(Root,params=[values]) Root ::= { (Mode | [Leaf]) } @values; @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= 'a' @text;  }

name: mixed-sequence

name: depth
grammar: grammar Invalid { @package: invalid @whitespace: none @root @nestedCaptures @mapping(Root,params=[values]) Root ::= [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ [ (Mode | Leaf) ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] @values; @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= 'a' @text;  }

name: shared-shape-mismatch
grammar: grammar NestedMixed { @package: nestedmixed @whitespace: none token N = NumberParser @root Entry ::= First | Second; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Root,params=[values]) First ::= '[' { (Mode | Heat | Leaf | N | 'text' | '😀' | '\r\n') } @values ']'; @nestedCaptures @mapping(Root,params=[values]) Second ::= '(' [ (Mode | Heat | Leaf | N | 'text' | '😀' | '\r\n') ] @values ')'; @enum Mode ::= 'sync' | 'auto'; @enum Heat ::= 'hot' | 'cold'; @mapping(Leaf,params=[text]) Leaf ::= '<' ('a' | '😀') @text '>'; }
